mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.fixture_id, f.stage_id, e.team_id, e.player_id, e.event_type, e.minute, f.kickoff_at, e.created_by AS event_created_by FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id WHERE f.season_id = #{seasonId} AND f.status = 'FINISHED' AND e.event_type IN ('YELLOW_CARD', 'RED_CARD') ORDER BY COALESCE(f.kickoff_at, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'), f.id, e.minute, e.id
SELECT DISTINCT f.season_id FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id WHERE f.status = 'FINISHED' AND e.event_type IN ('YELLOW_CARD', 'RED_CARD') ORDER BY f.season_id
SELECT * FROM player_suspension WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND source_type IN ('YELLOW_ACCUMULATION', 'RED_CARD') ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO player_suspension (player_id, team_id, season_id, source_type, source_event_id, source_fixture_id, source_stage_id, reason, matches_total, matches_served, status, created_by) VALUES (#{playerId}, #{teamId}, #{seasonId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceEventId}, #{sourceFixtureId}, #{sourceStageId}, #{reason}, #{matchesTotal}, #{matchesServed}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_suspension_serving WHERE suspension_id = #{suspensionId} AND fixture_id = #{fixtureId}
